# Gingiris Growth Tools

> Curated growth tools and playbooks for developers and founders launching globally.
> Built from real experience: AFFiNE open source (60K GitHub stars), 30x Product Hunt #1.

## About

Gingiris is a growth resource site run by Iris, former COO of AFFiNE.
Base: Kunshan, China. Focus: open source and SaaS go-to-market for global launch.
